indices.
This is a mesh of the pixel-cell union.

pages.title: Scale and location have different signatures
pages.text:
Scale and location have diﬀerent signatures
Doubling both spacings quadruples area.
Translating the origin changes all positions while
preserving every triangle area.

pages.title: Refining the mesh does not refine the image
pages.text:
Reﬁning the mesh does not reﬁne the image
Subdividing triangles inside the same selected cells leaves the represented boundary
unchanged.
Resolving a ﬁner boundary requires additional image information or a new
geometric assumption.
Computational Cardiology Notes 19 / 20

pages.title: Label resampling
pages.text:
Label resampling
Nearest-neighbor resampling preserves the set of label values.
It need not preserve thin
connections, area or boundary position on a new target grid.
